title: Annual NLCD Land Cover data
description:
Annual Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF files are copied from `s3://usgs-landcover`, an AWS S3 requester-pays bucket.

References:

- https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/nlcd-product-suite
- https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/annual-national-land-cover-database

Data was copied with

```
aws s3 sync s3://usgs-landcover/annual-nlcd/c1/v1/cu/mosaic/ ./ --request-payer
aws s3 sync . s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/kylebarron/usgs-landcover/annual-nlcd/c1/v1/cu/mosaic/
```
